title: LayoutMarker
description: `<prefix>/seshi.json`, written once (If-None-Match) when a prefix is first used. It says the prefix holds seshi's layout, which canonical trace format its traces are, and which deployment and organization it belongs to: a server whose config names another refuses to start (X1.4). `seshi/layout/2` (F11.7) adds the mode the bucket is used in and the oldest seshi that may write it; a `seshi/layout/1` marker reads as mode unknown and no minimum version. Writers upgrade 1 to 2 (If-Match) only when a command sets one of the new fields.

trace_schema.description: The canonical trace format every trace object under the prefix is written in.

deployment_id.description: The deployment the prefix belongs to: config's `store.deployment_id`, or one generated by the first writer.

org.description: The organization the deployment serves (X1.1), once a config has named it.

created_by.description: The program that wrote the marker (`seshi/0.9.0`).

mode.description: Schema 2: which mode the bucket is used in now (F11.8): `server` (laptops upload through `seshi serve`) or `serverless` (laptops write it directly).

min_version.description: Schema 2: the oldest seshi that may write the bucket, as `0.10.0`. Older ones refuse to write and read with a warning.

mode_changed_by.description: Schema 2: the program that last set `mode` (`seshi/0.10.0`).
